items.title: The fossil fuel comeback is here
items.summary: The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade while renewable energy growth slows down, a new report shows. items.title: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
items.summary: CoreWeave had a bad week last week. Its bonds slipped into distressed territory by a common definition - when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they'd get from government bonds. Last Tuesady Chamath "SPAC King" Palihapitiya noticed the distressed debt, and also asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble. […]

items.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
items.summary: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown […]

items.title: Democrats think cracking down on AI could give them an edge
items.summary: Democrats could win back control of Congress this November, and if they do, they'll need to decide how to approach one of the country's newest and thorniest political issues: AI.
